visualCharacteristics.summary: Lump-sum investment calculator: amount, tenure (Year + Months inputs on a months slider) and expected annual growth sliders, with maturity value, principal and interest outputs and a CTA. Client-side only, annual compounding.

contentPattern.structure: One row per item: optional heading; field rows [label | min | max | default | step] identified by label keywords (amount, keep/tenure, grow/rate); one-cell output label rows (value/maturity, principal, interest); link row as CTA.
